question.zh: 脑子乱了、精力耗尽了、学不进去了怎么办？
question.en: Overthinking, drained, or struggling to retain new knowledge?

question.zh: 这件事值不值得做？我有没有致命盲区？
question.en: Is this worth doing? What are my fatal blind spots?

question.zh: 想法很模糊，怎么变成清晰的规格与边界？
question.en: How do I turn a fuzzy idea into crisp specs and boundaries?

question.zh: 怎么用最低成本做出来、跑稳定、守住隐私？
question.en: How do I build it lean, keep it stable, and guard privacy?

question.zh: 怎么让它看起来专业、有审美、有辨识度？
question.en: How do I make it look sharp, cohesive, and unmistakable?

question.zh: 怎么把观点写透、讲清楚、沉淀成长期资产？
question.en: How do I sharpen my voice and turn insights into lasting assets?

question.zh: 东西做出来了，怎么让人看见并愿意买单？
question.en: It's built—how do I get it seen and paid for?

question.zh: 这件重复的破事，怎么让系统以后自己干？
question.en: How do I automate this recurring chore for good?

question.zh: 这里面有没有坑？这笔账算下来划不划算？
question.en: Where are the legal traps, and do the unit economics work?

metaphor.zh: 给发烫的大脑按下物理复位键
metaphor.en: A physical reset button for an overheated brain

trigger.zh: 当你陷入无休止的过度思考、对遥远的不确定性焦虑，甚至连休息时都无法真正放松沉浸时。
trigger.en: When you're spiraling in overthinking, anxious about distant uncertainties, or unable to unwind even during downtime.

zh: 剥离抽象的现代焦虑，强制列出此刻物理层面的 3 个基本事实（安全、温饱、当下无致命威胁）
把脑中盘旋的担忧一分为二：“此刻能动”与“此刻不可控”
对不可控项挂起封存，只从可控项里挑 1 件 15 分钟内可完成的小动作立刻执行
en: Strip away abstract anxieties by listing 3 immediate physical facts (safe, fed, no imminent threat)
Split swirling worries into two buckets: actionable right now vs. out of your control today
Shelve the uncontrollable items and execute one 15-minute micro-action immediately

deliverable.zh: 一张极简《当下锚定单》（3 个物理事实 + 1 个 15 分钟微动作）
deliverable.en: A minimalist Present-Anchor Card (3 physical facts + 1 fifteen-minute micro-action)

current_stack.zh: 置顶对话协议 / 手机快捷指令（1 分钟文字或语音复位）
current_stack.en: Pinned chat protocol or mobile shortcut (1-minute text/voice reset)

anti_pattern.zh: 不要用它来逃避真正需要拍板的紧急危机；它是用来清噪的，不是用来装鸵鸟的。
anti_pattern.en: Don't use it to dodge genuine urgent crises; it clears mental noise, not real emergencies.

metaphor.zh: 给抽象概念焊上画面挂钩，直接钉进记忆
metaphor.en: Welding vivid visual hooks onto abstract concepts

trigger.zh: 当你跨界学习陌生硬核领域，当下看懂了原理，但过两天就忘、临场调用不出来时。
trigger.en: When learning an unfamiliar domain where everything makes sense today, but you draw a blank two days later.

zh: 剥离冗长定义，只提炼待记概念的 1 个核心特征或底层结构
将其强绑定到一个具象、有动作感或空间感的“编码物/画面”上
反向盲测还原：只看编码画面，强制用自己的话复述原概念并修补断裂处
en: Strip verbose definitions down to 1 core trait or structural mechanism
Bind the concept to a concrete, action-driven, or spatial visual anchor
Run a blind recall test: look only at the visual anchor, reconstruct the concept in your own words, and patch gaps

deliverable.zh: 一组高还原度的“编码画面 + 概念映射卡”
deliverable.en: A set of high-recall visual anchor & concept mapping cards

current_stack.zh: 自定义记忆编码 Skill + 间隔重复工具（Anki / 本地 Markdown）
current_stack.en: Custom Mnemonic Encoding Skill + spaced repetition (Anki / local Markdown)

anti_pattern.zh: 不要给查一下就能用的 API 参数或琐碎日期做编码；只给需要内化的底层框架用。
anti_pattern.en: Don't encode lookup trivia or syntax; reserve it for core mental models you need on tap.

metaphor.zh: 给深度工作拉上防切屏的物理警戒线
metaphor.en: A physical firewall protecting deep work blocks

trigger.zh: 当你上午写代码、中午改文案、下午调 UI，大脑在多个岗位间反复切屏导致全天精疲力竭却零交付时。
trigger.en: When juggling code, copy, and UI in the same morning leaves you drained with zero shipped output.

zh: 开工前锁定当前 90 分钟的唯一虚拟岗位（例如：只当工程师，拒绝审文案）
过程中冒出的跨岗位灵感或杂念，5 秒内丢进“暂存收件箱”，绝不顺手切窗口处理
计时结束后统一分拣暂存区，决定直接丢弃还是排入下一个专场
en: Lock a single virtual role for the next 90 minutes (e.g., Engineer only—no copywriting)
Dump any cross-role ideas or distractions into a Parking Lot inbox within 5 seconds without switching windows
Triage the Parking Lot only after the timer ends—either discard or schedule into a dedicated block

deliverable.zh: 一段无切屏污染的深度产出 + 一份分拣后的《暂存灵感队列》
deliverable.en: One uncontaminated deep-work deliverable + a triaged Parking Lot queue

current_stack.zh: 本地极简倒计时 + 一键速记脚本 / 语音转文字收件箱
current_stack.en: Local minimalist timer + one-key capture script or voice-to-text inbox

anti_pattern.zh: 不要把单次熔断设得超过 2 小时；也不要在等待外部紧急响应的窗口期强行开启。
anti_pattern.en: Don't set blocks longer than 2 hours, or activate it while awaiting time-critical external blockers.

metaphor.zh: 每周一次给大脑和半成品做断舍离
metaphor.en: A weekly declutter for your brain and half-built projects

trigger.zh: 当你手里攒了一堆“改天再做”的半成品、收藏夹吃灰，感觉隐隐焦虑却说不清在忙什么时。
trigger.en: When half-finished projects and unread bookmarks pile up, creating background anxiety with unclear progress.

zh: 列出本周已完成交付物与所有卡住的半成品清单
强制执行“三选一清仓”：继续推进（限 3 项）、明确归档放弃、或降级为低优备忘
提炼本周重复超过 2 次的摩擦点，指定 1 个下周要封装或自动化的目标
en: Export this week's shipped deliverables alongside all stalled work-in-progress
Force a 3-way purge: keep active (max 3), explicitly kill/archive, or demote to backlog
Spot any friction repeated more than twice this week and pick 1 target to templatize or automate next week

deliverable.zh: 一份《周度清仓报告》（3 项主线 + 主动放弃清单 + 1 个待自动化摩擦点）
deliverable.en: A Weekly Purge Report (top 3 priorities + explicit kill list + 1 friction point to automate)

current_stack.zh: 固定周日复盘模板 + 15 分钟 AI 对话式引导访谈
current_stack.en: Fixed Sunday review template + 15-minute AI-guided interview

anti_pattern.zh: 不要把它写成自我检讨的流水账日记；核心是做“减法决策”，不是抒发愧疚。
anti_pattern.en: Don't turn it into a guilt-ridden journal; the goal is ruthless subtraction, not self-criticism.

metaphor.zh: 雇一个专门唱反调的毒舌合伙人
metaphor.en: A ruthless co-founder paid to kill your bad ideas

trigger.zh: 当你对一个新点子极度兴奋、准备立刻熬夜开工，但身边没人给你泼冷水时。
trigger.en: When you're hyped about a new idea and ready to build, with no one around to challenge your blind spots.

zh: 把你的方案压缩成 3 句话的核心假设
强制 AI 站在“做空者/竞争对手”立场，列出 3 个最致命的死法
对每个死法追问：有没有低成本的证伪实验（48 小时内可验证）
en: Compress your plan into 3 core assumptions
Force the AI into a short-seller/competitor persona to list 3 fatal failure modes
For each failure mode, design a low-cost falsification test runnable within 48 hours

deliverable.zh: 一份含 3 个致命死法与对应 48 小时证伪实验的《排雷清单》
deliverable.en: A Failure-Mode Checklist with 3 fatal risks and 48-hour falsification tests

current_stack.zh: 高推理模型对话 + 禁用顺从偏好的 System Prompt
current_stack.en: Reasoning model chat + strict anti-sycophancy System Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要在灵感刚萌芽、还没成形时使用，否则容易把好苗子过早扼杀。
anti_pattern.en: Don't use during raw brainstorming; it kills fragile ideas before they take shape.

metaphor.zh: 扒掉行业惯例的外壳，只看底层物理约束
metaphor.en: Stripping away industry dogma down to raw constraints

trigger.zh: 当你陷入“别人都这么做，所以我也要做”的惯性，或者觉得某个方案成本高得离谱时。
trigger.en: When you're copying competitors out of habit or facing a seemingly impossible cost barrier.

zh: 列出当前主流做法中默认成立的 5 条“行业常识”
逐条拷问：这是物理/法律铁律，还是历史遗留的习惯？
删掉所有非铁律约束，仅基于剩余底线重新拼装最简解法
en: List 5 unspoken assumptions baked into the current standard approach
Interrogate each: is this a hard law of physics/economics, or just legacy convention?
Delete every convention and rebuild the simplest solution from the remaining hard constraints

deliverable.zh: 一张《真约束 vs. 伪惯例》对照表及 1 个非共识替代方案
deliverable.en: A Hard-Constraints vs. Conventions table plus 1 non-consensus alternative

current_stack.zh: 多轮苏格拉底追问 Prompt + 思维导图/白板
current_stack.en: Multi-turn Socratic Prompt + whiteboard

anti_pattern.zh: 不要在已有成熟廉价标准件的琐事上重造轮子，把这把刀留给核心差异化环节。
anti_pattern.en: Don't reinvent cheap commodity parts; save this scalpel for core differentiation.

metaphor.zh: 不看对手吹什么，只盯用户骂什么和定价怎么变
metaphor.en: Ignoring competitor hype to track user complaints and pricing shifts

trigger.zh: 当你想切入一个细分赛道，需要快速看清现有玩家的真实软肋与未被满足的缺口时。
trigger.en: When entering a niche and needing to spot incumbents' real weaknesses and unmet gaps fast.

zh: 锁定 3–5 个标杆竞品，抓取其差评区、更新日志（Changelog）与定价页
让 AI 按“高频吐槽点 / 过度臃肿功能 / 隐形门槛”三个维度聚类
提炼出 1 个对手因为船大难掉头而不敢做的切入点
en: Pick 3–5 benchmark competitors and collect their 1-star reviews, changelogs, and pricing pages
Cluster findings into recurring complaints, bloated features, and hidden friction
Extract 1 wedge opportunity incumbents are too slow or conflicted to pursue

deliverable.zh: 一份《竞品软肋与切入点一页纸报告》
deliverable.en: A 1-page Competitor Weaknesses & Wedge Opportunity brief

current_stack.zh: 联网搜索模型 + 结构化信息抽取模板
current_stack.en: Web-enabled LLM + structured extraction template

anti_pattern.zh: 不要天天盯着竞品动态产生焦虑，也不要变成“对手加什么功能我就抄什么”。
anti_pattern.en: Don't obsess over daily competitor moves or fall into reactive feature-copying.

metaphor.zh: 小事秒拍板，大事慢三拍
metaphor.en: Move fast on reversible calls; slow down on irreversible ones

trigger.zh: 当你在技术选型、定价、合作或域名等决定上反复纠结，白白耗掉好几天时。
trigger.en: When you're paralyzed for days over a tech stack, pricing, or partnership choice.

zh: 判定该决定属于“双向门”（错了 48 小时内可低成本撤回）还是“单向门”（不可逆）
双向门直接设 15 分钟倒计时拍板，禁止继续调研
单向门则列出“最坏结果 + 止损底线 + 必须满足的 3 个前提条件”后再做决定
en: Classify the call as a Two-Way Door (reversible within 48h) or One-Way Door (irreversible)
For Two-Way Doors, set a 15-minute timer, decide, and ban further research
For One-Way Doors, define the worst-case floor, stop-loss line, and 3 non-negotiable criteria

deliverable.zh: 一份带止损线与复盘日期的《决策备忘录》
deliverable.en: A Decision Memo with stop-loss criteria and a scheduled review date

current_stack.zh: 极简决策判定 Prompt + 本地决策日志（Markdown）
current_stack.en: Decision triage Prompt + local Markdown decision log

anti_pattern.zh: 不要把本可以随时改掉的小事（如按钮颜色、初期文案）当成单向门来开会研究。
anti_pattern.en: Don't treat easily reversible tweaks (like copy or colors) as high-stakes One-Way Doors.

metaphor.zh: 把三个月的宏大蓝图，砍成 48 小时能上线的核心切片
metaphor.en: Slicing a 3-month roadmap down to a 48-hour shippable core

trigger.zh: 当你越想功能越多，登录、权限、后台、社区全想一起做，导致项目迟迟无法上线时。
trigger.en: When feature creep hits—auth, admin panels, communities—and your project never ships.

zh: 写出你脑中完整的理想功能清单
强制划出一条红线：删掉它，核心价值是否依然成立？（能删的全进 V2 冰柜）
把留下的最小闭环压成 1 条主路径，确保 1 个周末内能跑通交付
en: Dump your entire dream feature list onto paper
Apply one brutal filter: if we cut this, does the core value survive? Freeze everything else for V2
Compress the survivors into a single happy path shippable in one weekend

deliverable.zh: 一份《V1 必做清单（限 3 项）》与一份《V2 冰柜清单》
deliverable.en: A V1 Must-Ship list (max 3 items) and a V2 Icebox list

current_stack.zh: 需求裁剪对话协议 + Markdown Scope 文档
current_stack.en: Scope-cutting protocol + Markdown scope doc

anti_pattern.zh: 裁剪的是“锦上添花的功能”，不是“核心体验的完成度”；别把 MVP 做成无法使用的残次品。
anti_pattern.en: Cut nice-to-have scope, not core reliability—an MVP still has to be genuinely usable.

metaphor.zh: 先搭好不重不漏的抽屉，再往里装东西
metaphor.en: Building mutually exclusive drawers before filling them

trigger.zh: 当你要做知识库、卡片库、产品目录或数据结构，但分类总是互相打架、越加越乱时。
trigger.en: When building a library, directory, or data model where categories keep overlapping and breaking.

zh: 分离“前台心智模型（用户怎么找）”与“后台正交标签（系统怎么筛）”
对相邻分类强制写出“裁决线”（明确某类灰色内容归 A 不归 B）
锁定受控词表（Enum）与单条记录 Schema，先跑通 4 条样板数据再扩量
en: Separate front-end mental models (how users browse) from back-end orthogonal tags (how systems filter)
Write explicit boundary rules for every pair of adjacent categories
Lock controlled vocabularies (enums) and record schemas, then stress-test with 4 sample records

deliverable.zh: 一份含分类边界裁决线与 JSON Schema 的《DESIGN.md》
deliverable.en: A DESIGN.md spec with boundary rules and a locked JSON Schema

current_stack.zh: 多轮架构对齐对话 + JSON Schema / 校验脚本
current_stack.en: Iterative design-first chat + JSON Schema / validation script

anti_pattern.zh: 不要在只有 5 条零散笔记时过度设计三层嵌套分类，体量上来再抽象。
anti_pattern.en: Don't over-engineer 3-level taxonomies for 5 loose notes; wait until volume demands structure.

metaphor.zh: 上线前先雇一群“手欠用户”把产品摔一遍
metaphor.en: Stress-testing your product against chaotic real-world inputs before launch

trigger.zh: 当你的功能在自己电脑上跑得很完美，准备发给真实用户前的最后 1 小时。
trigger.en: Right before shipping, when everything works smoothly on your machine under ideal conditions.

zh: 按 4 类极端态逐一拷问：空状态（0 数据）、超长文本/双语换行、弱网/断网、非法或重复点击
检查移动端窄屏与深浅色模式下的遮挡与溢出
把高发致命边缘态补上优雅降级提示，低频项记录在案
en: Audit 4 extreme states: empty data, ultra-long/bilingual text overflow, offline/slow network, and duplicate/invalid inputs
Check narrow mobile viewports and dark/light mode contrast
Add graceful fallbacks for high-impact edge cases and log the rest

deliverable.zh: 一份已勾选修复的《上线前边缘态通关表》
deliverable.en: A signed-off Pre-Launch Edge-Case Audit sheet

current_stack.zh: 固定审计 Prompt + 浏览器设备模拟器
current_stack.en: Standard audit Prompt + browser DevTools device emulator

anti_pattern.zh: 不要为了修复发生概率万分之一的极端 Bug 而无限推迟首次发布。
anti_pattern.en: Don't delay launch indefinitely chasing 0.01% theoretical edge cases.

metaphor.zh: 强迫自己失忆，以完全陌生人的眼睛看前 30 秒
metaphor.en: Simulating total amnesia to experience your product's first 30 seconds

trigger.zh: 当你对自己的产品太熟悉，已经看不出新用户进来第一眼会卡在哪里时。
trigger.en: When you're so close to your own product that you can't see where a newcomer gets lost.

zh: 截下首屏到完成首次核心动作的 3–5 步连续截图
让 AI 扮演“毫无背景、只有 30 秒耐心的陌生访客”，逐屏说出困惑点
砍掉首次体验前的所有非必要弹窗、注册墙或术语解释
en: Capture 3–5 sequential screenshots from landing to the first 'aha' action
Have AI roleplay an impatient first-time visitor with zero context to call out every point of confusion
Remove any non-essential modals, sign-up walls, or jargon blocking that first action

deliverable.zh: 一份标注了 3 个最大流失摩擦点的《首屏体验改造单》
deliverable.en: A First-Run Friction Report highlighting the top 3 drop-off points

current_stack.zh: 多模态视觉模型 + 连续截图走查
current_stack.en: Vision-capable LLM + sequential screenshot walkthrough

anti_pattern.zh: 不要用“加一段更长的新手引导文字”来解决界面本身不直观的问题。
anti_pattern.en: Don't patch an unintuitive UI by slapping a longer onboarding tooltip on top of it.

metaphor.zh: 甩掉构建工具包袱，原生三件套直接上线
metaphor.en: Ditching heavy bundlers to ship raw HTML, CSS, and JS

trigger.zh: 当你只想快速上线一个工具站或展示库，却被 Webpack、npm 依赖冲突和服务器运维劝退时。
trigger.en: When you just want to ship a lightweight web tool, but npm dependency hell and server ops slow you down.

zh: 采用原生 HTML + CSS Variables + ES Modules，彻底跳过前端构建打包环节
数据层全部抽离为纯静态 JSON，通过原生 fetch 加载与前端过滤
直接托管至 GitHub Pages 或 Cloudflare Pages，实现零服务器账单与秒级全球分发
en: Use native HTML, CSS Variables, and ES Modules to eliminate build steps entirely
Decouple content into plain static JSON files loaded via native fetch
Deploy directly to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for zero server bills and instant global delivery

deliverable.zh: 一套零 npm 依赖、开箱即部署的静态站基础仓库模板
deliverable.en: A zero-dependency static site boilerplate ready for instant deployment

current_stack.zh: 原生 HTML/CSS/JS + GitHub Pages + GitHub Actions
current_stack.en: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS + GitHub Pages + GitHub Actions

anti_pattern.zh: 不要强行用纯静态站去扛需要复杂后端鉴权、实时多人协作或高并发写入的业务。
anti_pattern.en: Don't force static architecture onto apps needing complex server-side auth or real-time multi-user writes.

metaphor.zh: 别让 AI 瞎猜改代码，先用二分法把 Bug 逼进死角
metaphor.en: Cornering bugs via binary isolation instead of blind AI guessing

trigger.zh: 当代码报错，你把整段报错甩给 AI 却越改越乱、陷入“修一个坏两个”的死循环时。
trigger.en: When pasting stack traces into AI triggers a whack-a-mole loop that breaks more than it fixes.

zh: 禁止 AI 直接重写代码，先要求它基于报错日志列出 3 个最可能的根因假设
在数据流中点插入最小化日志探针，用二分法一刀切掉一半嫌疑范围
拿到实测输出锁定唯一根因后，再执行最小侵入式修复并补充回归用例
en: Forbid the AI from rewriting code immediately; require 3 ranked root-cause hypotheses from the logs first
Insert a minimal probe halfway through the data flow to bisect the suspect surface in half
Once empirical output confirms the exact cause, apply the smallest surgical fix and add a regression check

deliverable.zh: 一份《根因定位记录》与最小侵入式代码补丁
deliverable.en: A confirmed root-cause diagnosis paired with a minimal surgical patch

current_stack.zh: Cursor / 代码模型 + 强制“先诊断后动刀”的 Debug 协议
current_stack.en: Cursor / coding LLM + strict diagnose-before-patching protocol

anti_pattern.zh: 不要在还没复现稳定报错路径之前，就急着让 AI 大面积重构无关模块。
anti_pattern.en: Don't let AI refactor unrelated modules before you can reliably reproduce the failure.

title.zh: 自动化校验 CI 门禁

metaphor.zh: 在上线前装一道冷酷的自动安检门
metaphor.en: An automated security checkpoint before anything hits production

trigger.zh: 当你一个人维护几十上百条数据或代码文件，生怕手滑改错一个逗号或拼错 ID 导致线上白屏时。
trigger.en: When maintaining growing data or code solo, fearing one typo or broken ID will crash production.

zh: 用原生脚本（如 Node .mjs）写出核心不变量检查：JSON 语法、必填字段、ID 唯一性与引用完整性
在 GitHub Actions 配置 push 触发工作流，校验不通过直接阻断部署
每次线上踩过一个新坑，就往校验脚本里补一条对应的防复发规则
en: Write a zero-dependency script (e.g., Node .mjs) asserting core invariants: valid JSON, required fields, unique IDs, and referential integrity
Wire it into GitHub Actions on every push to block deployment upon any failure
Every time a new bug slips through, encode a permanent rule into the gate so it never recurs

deliverable.zh: 一套本地与云端双运行的校验脚本 + GitHub Actions 流水线文件
deliverable.en: A local/CI validation script paired with a GitHub Actions workflow YAML

current_stack.zh: Node.js 原生脚本 + GitHub Actions CI/CD
current_stack.en: Native Node.js script + GitHub Actions CI/CD

anti_pattern.zh: 不要一开始就搭复杂的端到端测试集群，先守住“数据不坏、页面不挂”的 80/20 底线。
anti_pattern.en: Don't build a bloated E2E suite on day one; guard the 80/20 invariants that prevent total breakage first.

title.zh: 本地优先隐私架构模版

metaphor.zh: 敏感数据锁死在自己硬盘里，绝不上传云端
metaphor.en: Locking sensitive data on local hardware, completely off the cloud

trigger.zh: 当你处理日记、财务账单、医疗记录或未公开商业源码等高度敏感内容，不放心喂给云端 API 时。
trigger.en: When processing diaries, financials, medical records, or private IP that you refuse to upload to cloud APIs.

zh: 强制数据存储与索引完全留在本地文件系统（SQLite / Markdown / IndexedDB）
接入端侧小模型（如 Ollama / WebGPU）处理脱敏、摘要与检索，物理断网亦可运行
若确需调用云端大模型，先经本地脚本完成实体脱敏（替换人名、金额、账号）再出网
en: Keep all storage and indexing strictly on the local filesystem (SQLite, Markdown, or IndexedDB)
Run on-device small models (Ollama / WebGPU) for offline summarization and retrieval
If cloud reasoning is strictly required, pass text through a local PII-redaction script before sending

deliverable.zh: 一份《离线隐私架构方案》与本地脱敏预处理脚本
deliverable.en: An offline-first architecture blueprint plus a local PII-redaction script

current_stack.zh: Ollama / 本地小模型 + 浏览器 IndexedDB / 本地 CLI
current_stack.en: Ollama / on-device SLM + browser IndexedDB or local CLI

anti_pattern.zh: 不要拿端侧小模型去硬扛超长上下文复杂推理，合理拆分“本地脱敏/检索 + 云端重推理”的边界。
anti_pattern.en: Don't force tiny local models into heavy multi-step reasoning; split local privacy from cloud compute cleanly.

title.zh: 截图级 UI 毒舌诊断器

metaphor.zh: 请一位审美极高的设计总监盯着你的截图挑刺
metaphor.en: A ruthless design director tearing apart your UI screenshots

trigger.zh: 当你自己写完前端页面，总觉得“哪里土土的、像程序员写的”，却说不出具体该改哪几个像素时。
trigger.en: When your hand-coded UI feels amateurish, but you can't pinpoint which pixels or spacing rules are off.

zh: 截取完整首屏与移动端窄屏两张图，喂给多模态模型
强制按“视觉层级、留白呼吸感、对比度、对齐精度”4 个维度只挑毛病、禁止夸奖
要求每一条批评必须附带具体的 CSS 修改数值（如字号、行高、padding、色值）
en: Feed full desktop and mobile viewport screenshots into a vision-capable model
Enforce zero-praise critique across 4 axes: visual hierarchy, whitespace, contrast, and alignment
Require every critique to include exact CSS fixes (font sizes, line-heights, padding, hex codes)

deliverable.zh: 一份带具体 CSS 像素/色值修改建议的《界面整容清单》
deliverable.en: A UI Facelift Checklist with exact CSS property adjustments

current_stack.zh: 多模态视觉模型 + 固定 UI 评审 System Prompt
current_stack.en: Vision LLM + strict UI critique System Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要一次把 20 条建议全改完；每次只改影响最大的前 3 条（通常是留白和层级），再重新截图复查。
anti_pattern.en: Don't apply 20 tweaks at once; fix the top 3 hierarchy/spacing issues first, then re-evaluate.

metaphor.zh: 把色板、字体和间距写进宪法，告别随手乱配色
metaphor.en: Codifying colors, type, and spacing so you never eyeball styles again

trigger.zh: 当你的页面越写越多，按钮颜色、圆角大小和字体层级开始各自为战、整体显得杂乱时。
trigger.en: When growing pages accumulate inconsistent grays, random border-radii, and mismatched typography.

zh: 锁定极简色板：1 个主背景、1 个卡片表面、2 级文字灰度、1 个高识别度强调色
锁定 4px/8px 基准间距阶梯与 4 级字号标尺（标题、副标、正文、铭牌）
将上述规则全部封装为 CSS `:root` 变量文件，后续开发严禁写死魔法数值
en: Lock a strict palette: 1 canvas background, 1 surface, 2 text grays, and 1 signature accent
Lock a 4px/8px spacing scale and a 4-step typography ramp (display, heading, body, meta)
Export everything into a CSS :root tokens file and ban hardcoded magic values thereafter

deliverable.zh: 一份可直接引用的 `tokens.css` 视觉宪法文件
deliverable.en: A drop-in tokens.css file governing the entire visual system

current_stack.zh: 原生 CSS Custom Properties + AI 配色对比度校验
current_stack.en: Native CSS Custom Properties + AI contrast-ratio checker

anti_pattern.zh: 不要为个人项目照搬大厂上百个 Token 的设计系统，15 个核心变量足够撑起极高质感。
anti_pattern.en: Don't copy enterprise 200-token design systems; 15 disciplined variables deliver better craft solo.

metaphor.zh: 给 AI 画师和作曲家发同一本美术设定集
metaphor.en: Handing your AI illustrators and composers the exact same art bible

trigger.zh: 当你用 AI 生成配图、封面或音视频素材时，每张单看不错，拼在一起却画风割裂像拼夕夕时。
trigger.en: When AI-generated illustrations, covers, or media look fine alone but clash wildly when placed together.

zh: 确定 1 种极具辨识度的统一美学锚点（如特定插画流派、纸张质感、固定主色调）
把风格描述词拆成“不可变底座（画风/光线/材质）”与“可变槽位（主体/动作）”
每次生成新素材只替换可变槽位，并用参考图（Style Reference）锁死一致性
en: Choose one unmistakable aesthetic anchor (specific illustration movement, paper grain, fixed palette)
Split prompts into an immutable Style Base (medium, lighting, texture) and a swappable Subject Slot
Swap only the subject per asset and enforce consistency with reference images

deliverable.zh: 一套可复用的《视觉/音视频风格锁定 Prompt 模板》与参考图包
deliverable.en: A reusable Style-Lock Prompt template paired with a curated reference pack

current_stack.zh: 图像/音乐生成工具 + 固定 Style Prompt 片段库
current_stack.en: Image/audio generation tools + reusable Style Prompt library

anti_pattern.zh: 不要往风格底座里堆砌互相冲突的修饰词（如同时写“极简扁平”和“超写实 8K 虚幻引擎”）。
anti_pattern.en: Don't stuff conflicting keywords into the base (e.g., 'minimalist flat' alongside 'photorealistic 8K').

title.zh: 高审美界面逆向拆解器

metaphor.zh: 把神仙网站的布局与留白规律，翻译成自己的 CSS
metaphor.en: Translating world-class site layouts and rhythm into your own CSS

trigger.zh: 当你看到一个极度克制高级的网站，想学它的设计语言，却不知从何下手转化为代码时。
trigger.en: When you spot a stunning website and want to absorb its spatial rhythm into code without copying it blindly.

zh: 截取参考网站的 2–3 个关键区块，要求 AI 剥离具体业务内容，只提炼“栅格比例、留白节奏、边框与阴影克制度”
将其抽象为 5 条可迁移的布局原则（而非照抄像素）
直接生成基于该原则的极简 HTML/CSS 骨架 Demo 供自己二次改造
en: Feed 2–3 key sections of a reference site and ask AI to ignore content, extracting only grid ratios, whitespace rhythm, and border/shadow restraint
Distill those observations into 5 transferable layout rules rather than pixel-copying
Generate a clean HTML/CSS skeleton applying those rules to your own content

deliverable.zh: 一份《参考界面设计语言拆解单》+ 可运行的极简布局 Demo
deliverable.en: A Design-Language Breakdown sheet plus a runnable minimalist layout demo

current_stack.zh: 多模态模型 + 浏览器检查器（DevTools）
current_stack.en: Vision LLM + browser DevTools

anti_pattern.zh: 拆解的是“骨架规律与克制感”，绝不是直接扒别人的品牌色和文案做山寨克隆。
anti_pattern.en: Extract structural rhythm and restraint—never clone another brand's exact palette or copy.

metaphor.zh: 一键洗掉“总而言之”的廉价 AI 味
metaphor.en: Scrubbing generic AI-speak out to preserve your real voice

trigger.zh: 当你让 AI 辅助写文章或产品文案，读起来却满屏“不仅如此、值得注意的是、赋能”，完全不像人话时。
trigger.en: When AI-assisted drafts read like corporate fluff ('delve', 'moreover', 'in today's fast-paced world') instead of you.

zh: 喂入 3 篇你最满意的亲笔旧作，让 AI 逆向提炼你的句式长短、用词偏好与情绪克制度
建立一份《禁用词黑名单》（拉黑所有翻译腔、播音腔和空洞形容词）
每次成稿后过一遍校准器，强制删掉铺垫废话，保留具象细节与个人判断
en: Feed 3 of your best human-written pieces so AI extracts your sentence cadence, vocabulary, and restraint
Maintain an explicit Banned-Words Blacklist killing filler transitions and hollow adjectives
Run every draft through the calibrator to cut throat-clearing intros and sharpen concrete specifics

deliverable.zh: 一份可常驻上下文的《个人写作风格宪法（Tone Guide）》
deliverable.en: A persistent Personal Tone-of-Voice Guide ready to inject into any chat

current_stack.zh: 个人风格 Prompt 文件 + 禁用词检查清单
current_stack.en: Personal style Prompt file + banned-word checklist

anti_pattern.zh: 不要试图用风格指南掩盖“本来就没想清楚观点”的硬伤；没干货的文章洗完还是空的。
anti_pattern.en: Style calibration can't rescue an empty argument; fix the thinking before polishing the voice.

metaphor.zh: 先焊死论证钢筋，再浇筑文字水泥
metaphor.en: Welding the argument's steel frame before pouring any prose

trigger.zh: 当你脑子里有一堆零散洞察想写成深度长文，但动笔就跑偏、写到一半逻辑散架时。
trigger.en: When you have sharp scattered insights for a deep essay, but the draft rambles and loses structure halfway.

zh: 把所有碎片想法语音转文字或无序倒出，不追求通顺
让 AI 帮你找出 1 个核心论点（Thesis），并将碎片重排为“反常识钩子 → 痛点拆解 → 底层机制 → 落地解法”的论证链
检查相邻段落之间是否存在逻辑断层或循环论证，确认骨架无误后再展开写正文
en: Brain-dump all raw fragments via voice or bullet notes without worrying about flow
Extract 1 central thesis and arrange fragments into a tight arc: hook, tension, mechanism, and resolution
Audit transitions between sections for logical leaps before drafting a single full paragraph

deliverable.zh: 一份带逐段核心句与论据锚点的《长文逻辑大纲》
deliverable.en: A structural outline with topic sentences and evidence anchors for every section

current_stack.zh: 语音速记 + 逻辑大纲构建 Prompt
current_stack.en: Voice-to-text capture + outline-architect Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要直接让 AI 根据大纲一键生成 3000 字全文；骨架可以合搭，关键观点和案例必须自己写。
anti_pattern.en: Don't let AI auto-expand the outline into 3,000 words; co-build the skeleton, write the core insights yourself.

metaphor.zh: 不是逐字翻译，而是用另一种语言重新表达一遍
metaphor.en: Re-expressing ideas natively instead of word-for-word translation

trigger.zh: 当你要做中英双语产品、文档或卡片库，机翻出来的英文僵硬别扭、丢失原本的犀利感时。
trigger.en: When building bilingual products or docs where literal translation kills the punch and reads awkwardly.

zh: 先要求 AI 用一句话提炼原句的“真实意图与语气色彩”（如冷峻、幽默、克制）
严禁逐词直译，要求直接按目标语言的母语习惯重写 2 个版本（标准版 vs. 极简犀利版）
检查产品术语与 UI 标签在全站范围内的译名一致性
en: First have AI state the source text's core intent and tonal register (dry, witty, crisp)
Ban literal translation; generate 2 native rewrites (standard vs. punchy/minimalist)
Cross-check domain terms and UI labels for strict consistency across the entire project

deliverable.zh: 一组无翻译腔的双语对照文案与《项目术语表》
deliverable.en: Native-grade bilingual copy paired with a consistent Project Glossary

current_stack.zh: 双语本地化 Prompt + 项目术语对照表（JSON/Markdown）
current_stack.en: Localization Prompt + project glossary (JSON/Markdown)

anti_pattern.zh: 不要在 UI 按钮或短卡片上追求字数完全对称；英文通常更占宽度，要优先保证自然简洁。
anti_pattern.en: Don't force equal character counts on UI labels; prioritize native brevity and check layout overflow.

metaphor.zh: 把干瘪的专业术语，压成一眼记住的具象画面
metaphor.en: Compressing dry jargon into vivid, unforgettable mental hooks

trigger.zh: 当你写完一个好产品或好观点，却发现标题平淡无奇、一句话说不清它到底牛在哪时。
trigger.en: When you've built something great, but your headline is bland and takes three paragraphs to explain.

zh: 输入核心机制或产品功能，找出读者最熟悉的 3 个日常物理隐喻（如工具箱、安检门、手术刀）
强制用“反差对比”或“动作画面”重写成 15 字以内的短句（例如：从 X 变成 Y）
做“陌生人 3 秒盲测”：删掉所有行业黑话，看外行能不能瞬间听懂
en: Map your abstract feature onto 3 familiar physical metaphors (toolbox, circuit breaker, scalpel)
Rewrite into a crisp sub-10-word hook using sharp contrast or concrete action
Run a 3-second outsider test: strip all jargon until a non-expert gets it instantly

deliverable.zh: 5 个备选高传播度 Slogan / 隐喻钩子
deliverable.en: 5 sharp candidate slogans or metaphor hooks

current_stack.zh: 隐喻联想 Prompt + 个人金句灵感库
current_stack.en: Metaphor-mapping Prompt + personal swipe file

anti_pattern.zh: 不要为了押韵或抖机灵而牺牲准确性；好的隐喻是降低理解成本，不是制造歧义。
anti_pattern.en: Never sacrifice accuracy for clever wordplay; a good metaphor clarifies, not confuses.

metaphor.zh: 写透一篇母本，自动拆出全平台弹药
metaphor.en: Turning one deep piece into native ammo for every channel

trigger.zh: 当你花三天写出一篇深度长文或做完一个项目，发完一次就沉底，没精力再挨个平台重写时。
trigger.en: When you spend days on a deep essay or launch, post it once, and lack the energy to rewrite it for other platforms.

zh: 锁定 1 份高密度母本（长文、设计文档或项目复盘）作为唯一信源
按目标平台的原生语境拆解：长推文串（钩子+反转）、图文卡片（3 条金句）、极简社区帖（纯干货无推广味）
为每个渠道保留独立观察标签，1 周后只保留转化最高的前 2 个渠道持续投入
en: Anchor on 1 high-density source asset (essay, design doc, or postmortem) as the single source of truth
Atomize natively per channel: a sharp thread (hook + twist), visual carousel (3 takeaways), and a zero-fluff community post
Track response per channel and cut everything except the top 2 performers after a week

deliverable.zh: 一套适配 3–4 个不同平台的原生分发文案包
deliverable.en: A native multi-channel distribution pack ready for 3–4 platforms

current_stack.zh: 多平台改写 Skill + 个人语调校准器（edt-01）
current_stack.en: Multi-channel repurposing Skill + Tone-of-Voice Calibrator (edt-01)

anti_pattern.zh: 不要把同一段文字直接复制粘贴到所有平台；不同社区的语境和反感点完全不同。
anti_pattern.en: Never copy-paste the exact same block everywhere; each community has distinct norms and triggers.

title.zh: 着陆页 5 秒转化诊断

metaphor.zh: 用陌生访客的 5 秒耐心，拷问首屏说清了没
metaphor.en: Testing if a cold visitor gets your value in 5 seconds flat

trigger.zh: 当你把产品链接发出去，有不少人点进来，但几乎没人试用、收藏或留资时。
trigger.en: When people click your launch link, bounce immediately, and nobody tries or bookmarks the product.

zh: 只截取首屏（不滚动）喂给 AI，强制回答 3 个问题：这是什么、给谁用、我现在该点哪里
删掉所有宏大叙事与自嗨口号（如“重新定义下一代……”），换成具象痛点与结果
把核心行动按钮（CTA）和真实交互预览提到首屏视觉中心
en: Feed only the above-the-fold screenshot to AI and force 3 answers: what is it, who is it for, what do I click next?
Delete grandiloquent slogans ('redefining the next generation of...') in favor of concrete outcomes
Move the primary CTA and a live interactive preview directly into the first viewport

deliverable.zh: 一份《首屏 5 秒诊断报告》及 3 组可直接替换的主副标题
deliverable.en: A 5-Second Above-the-Fold Audit with 3 ready-to-swap hero headline options

current_stack.zh: 多模态视觉模型 + 首屏转化检查 Prompt
current_stack.en: Vision LLM + landing-page conversion audit Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要在首屏堆砌 5 个同样显眼的按钮；一次只引导访客做 1 个最关键的动作。
anti_pattern.en: Don't cram 5 competing buttons above the fold; guide visitors toward one unmistakable action.

metaphor.zh: 同时讨好传统搜索引擎与 AI 问答的引用偏好
metaphor.en: Structuring pages so both search engines and AI answers cite you

trigger.zh: 当你做出了高质量的开源工具、文档或专栏，却在搜索和大模型问答里完全搜不到自己时。
trigger.en: When you publish a solid tool or guide, yet remain invisible in both Google and AI search answers.

zh: 为每个核心页面补齐清晰的语义标签（Title、Description、Open Graph、JSON-LD 结构化数据）
在正文开头用 2–3 句话给出“可直接被 AI 摘录引用”的清晰定义与核心对比表
用真实用户会搜的自然语言问题作为小标题，而非晦涩的内部代号
en: Add clean semantic metadata to every page (Title, Description, Open Graph, and JSON-LD schema)
Lead with a crisp 2-sentence definition and structured comparison tables that AI engines can cite verbatim
Use natural questions real users actually ask as headings instead of internal jargon

deliverable.zh: 一套可直接嵌入 `<head>` 的元数据模板 + 页面语义结构优化清单
deliverable.en: A drop-in <head> metadata template plus a semantic structure checklist

current_stack.zh: 静态 HTML Meta 模板 + 语义优化 Prompt
current_stack.en: Static HTML Meta template + semantic audit Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要堆砌关键词写垃圾内容；在大模型检索时代，信息密度与原创结构比词频重要得多。
anti_pattern.en: Never stuff keywords into thin fluff; in AI search, original structure and density beat keyword spam.

title.zh: 冷启动种子用户话术库

metaphor.zh: 不群发、不卑微，精准敲开前 20 个用户的门
metaphor.en: Knocking on your first 20 users' doors without sounding like spam

trigger.zh: 当你的 V1 产品刚上线，需要找到前 20 个真实种子用户收集反馈，但不好意思开口推广时。
trigger.en: When your V1 just shipped and you need 20 real early users for feedback without feeling pushy.

zh: 在社区/评论区锁定正在吐槽该痛点的具体人，绝不盲目群发
采用“具体观察 + 免费解法 + 零压力退路”三段式短消息（控制在 100 字以内）
把每一次回复里的真实措辞记录下来，直接反哺成你的着陆页文案
en: Find specific people actively complaining about the exact problem in communities—never blast cold lists
Send a sub-80-word note: specific observation + free working fix + zero-pressure opt-out
Log the exact words prospects use in replies and recycle them straight into your landing page copy

deliverable.zh: 3 套不同场景（评论区、私信、老友内测）的极简触达话术模板
deliverable.en: 3 concise outreach templates for threads, DMs, and warm beta invites

current_stack.zh: 个性化触达 Prompt + 简易种子用户反馈表（Markdown）
current_stack.en: Personalized outreach Prompt + lightweight Markdown feedback log

anti_pattern.zh: 不要一上来就发长达三屏的产品介绍和收费链接；先提供价值、建立对话，再谈转化。
anti_pattern.en: Don't lead with a 3-paragraph pitch and a paywall; deliver value and start a conversation first.

metaphor.zh: 每天花 3 分钟看过滤后的情报，告别刷信息流
metaphor.en: A 3-minute filtered daily brief that replaces doomscrolling

trigger.zh: 当你每天在 X、GitHub、Hacker News 和公众号之间反复刷屏，耗掉两小时却只记住一堆焦虑时。
trigger.en: When bouncing between feeds, repos, and newsletters burns two hours a day and leaves only noise.

zh: 锁定不超过 10 个高信噪比信息源（RSS、特定仓库 Release、核心行业关键词）
通过定时任务自动抓取，用大模型按“与我当前项目相关度”打分并剔除标题党与重复新闻
每天固定时间推送一份不超过 5 条的极简摘要，附带原始链接供深度阅读
en: Lock at most 10 high-signal sources (RSS feeds, key repo releases, core domain keywords)
Run a scheduled job that scores items by relevance to your active projects and strips clickbait duplicates
Deliver a crisp daily digest capped at 5 items with direct source links

deliverable.zh: 每日自动送达的《5 条高信噪比情报简报》
deliverable.en: An automated daily 5-item high-signal intelligence digest

current_stack.zh: GitHub Actions Cron / n8n + RSS + 轻量模型摘要
current_stack.en: GitHub Actions Cron / n8n + RSS + lightweight LLM summarizer

anti_pattern.zh: 不要贪多订阅上百个源；简报超过 1 屏没人会看，最终只会变成新的未读焦虑。
anti_pattern.en: Don't subscribe to 100 feeds; any digest longer than one screen becomes another unread chore.

title.zh: 私有知识库自动归档流

metaphor.zh: 碎片灵感随手一扔，自动打标归位不吃灰
metaphor.en: Tossing raw sparks into an inbox that auto-tags and files itself

trigger.zh: 当你每天随手收藏了大量网页、对话金句和突发灵感，但过一周就再也找不到它们在哪时。
trigger.en: When bookmarks, chat insights, and random sparks pile up across apps and vanish when you need them.

zh: 设立唯一的碎片收集入口（如本地 Inbox 文件、快捷指令或私有仓库 Issue）
定期触发脚本调用模型，自动提取标题、3 个受控标签与 1 句话核心价值
按统一命名规范归档为纯文本 Markdown，确保未来十年不依赖任何闭源笔记软件
en: Funnel all loose sparks into a single capture inbox (local file, shortcut, or private repo issue)
Run an automated pass that extracts a clean title, 3 controlled tags, and a 1-line takeaway
File everything as plain Markdown with consistent naming—zero lock-in to proprietary note apps

deliverable.zh: 一套结构统一、可全文秒搜的本地 Markdown 知识库
deliverable.en: A cleanly structured, instantly searchable local Markdown knowledge base

current_stack.zh: 本地脚本 / Obsidian + AI 自动打标归档流
current_stack.en: Local script / Obsidian + AI auto-tagging pipeline

anti_pattern.zh: 不要收藏“以后可能会看”的万字长文原文；只归档经过你大脑筛选的核心片段或自己的评注。
anti_pattern.en: Don't hoard unread 10,000-word articles; archive only filtered excerpts and your own notes.

title.zh: API 额度与服务熔断哨兵

metaphor.zh: 给自动化流装上防刷爆账单的保险丝
metaphor.en: A fuse box stopping runaway agents from burning your API budget

trigger.zh: 当你跑起定时脚本、Agent 或公开小工具，生怕死循环一夜刷爆信用卡，或线上页面静默挂掉时。
trigger.en: When running cron agents or public tools and worrying a runaway loop will spike your bill or fail silently.

zh: 在所有大模型 API 后台强制设死“硬性月度消费上限（Hard Limit）”与 50%/80% 告警线
在自动化脚本里写入最大重试次数（Max Retries）与单次 Token 熔断阈值
配置免费定时拨测（Uptime Check），静态站或关键接口返回非 200 状态时立即发通知
en: Enforce hard monthly spend caps and 50%/80% billing alerts on every LLM API provider
Code strict max-retry limits and per-run token circuit breakers into every automated script
Set up free uptime pings that alert you immediately if a site or endpoint returns non-200

deliverable.zh: 一份《API 预算硬限清单》+ 自动化存活拨测告警流
deliverable.en: An API Hard-Limit checklist paired with automated uptime alerting

current_stack.zh: API 平台预算硬限 + GitHub Actions 拨测 / 免费 Uptime 监控
current_stack.en: Provider hard spend caps + GitHub Actions ping / free uptime monitor

anti_pattern.zh: 不要只在代码里写软限制而不开平台级硬限；代码本身可能出 Bug，平台账单锁才是最后底线。
anti_pattern.en: Never rely solely on code-level caps; buggy code can bypass them—provider-level hard limits are mandatory.

title.zh: 高频任务 Skill 封装器

metaphor.zh: 凡是重复敲了 3 遍的指令，直接铸成一键技能
metaphor.en: Casting any prompt you've typed three times into a reusable Skill

trigger.zh: 当你发现自己每周都在向 AI 重复解释同一套背景、格式要求和避坑规则，越写越烦时。
trigger.en: When you catch yourself re-explaining the same context, format, and guardrails to AI every week.

zh: 翻出最近 3 次最满意的同类对话记录，提取共性的输入参数、执行步骤与输出格式
把隐性默契写成显性的标准操作规程（SKILL.md），明确触发条件与禁止事项
存入个人公开或私有 Skills 仓库，每次实战发现新边缘情况就迭代更新版本号
en: Pull 3 successful past chats of the same task and extract shared inputs, steps, and output schemas
Codify implicit habits into an explicit SOP (SKILL.md) with clear triggers and guardrails
Store it in a versioned personal Skills repo and refine it whenever real-world edge cases surface

deliverable.zh: 一个可跨对话一键调用的标准化 Skill 模块
deliverable.en: A standardized, reusable Skill module callable across sessions

current_stack.zh: 自定义 AI Skills / Gems + GitHub 版本化托管
current_stack.en: Custom AI Skills / Gems + versioned GitHub repo

anti_pattern.zh: 不要为只干一次的临时活去封装复杂 Skill；严格遵守“事不过三”原则，第 3 次重复再动手封装。
anti_pattern.en: Don't package one-off tasks; follow the Rule of Three and codify only on the third repetition.

metaphor.zh: 签字前先用 X 光把霸王条款和隐形陷阱照出来
metaphor.en: X-raying contracts for hidden traps before you ever sign

trigger.zh: 当你接到外包单、平台协议或合作合同，面对密密麻麻十几页法律术语头大、怕踩坑时。
trigger.en: When facing a 15-page client contract, platform ToS, or partnership agreement packed with dense legalese.

zh: 将脱敏后的合同全文喂给模型，重点扫描 5 大雷区：知识产权归属、无限连带赔偿、单方解约权、付款账期、竞业限制
要求用大白话标出“高危红灯条款”，并解释最坏情况下你会损失什么
针对每条红灯条款生成 1 段礼貌但坚定的修改替代措辞发给对方协商
en: Feed the redacted contract to AI and scan 5 minefields: IP ownership, uncapped liability, unilateral termination, payment terms, and non-competes
Flag red-light clauses in plain language, spelling out the worst-case downside
Draft a polite, firm counter-clause for each red flag to send back for negotiation

deliverable.zh: 一份《高危条款红绿灯清单》及可直接复制的修改建议措辞
deliverable.en: A Red-Flag Clause Report with ready-to-send negotiation counter-language

current_stack.zh: 本地脱敏 + 长上下文推理模型合同审查 Prompt
current_stack.en: Local PII redaction + long-context reasoning contract-review Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 涉及大额资金、股权或跨境诉讼风险时，AI 只能做初筛准备，最终拍板必须找执业律师把关。
anti_pattern.en: For high-stakes equity, large sums, or cross-border disputes, AI is only a first pass—hire a licensed attorney.

title.zh: 定价与盈亏平衡模拟器

metaphor.zh: 别拍脑袋定个便宜价，先算清回本线和时薪底线
metaphor.en: Replacing gut-feel pricing with hard margin and break-even math

trigger.zh: 当你准备给自己的数字产品、订阅服务或咨询项目定价，纠结卖 9 块还是 99 块时。
trigger.en: When pricing a digital product, SaaS tier, or consulting offer and guessing between $9 and $99.

zh: 列出所有显性与隐性成本：固定工具/域名费、单用户 API 变动成本、支付渠道抽成与你的时间机会成本
建立 3 档价格与转化率假设（悲观 / 基准 / 乐观），算出各自达到盈亏平衡所需的最低付费人数
对比“薄利多销的客服噩梦”与“高客单小而美”，锁定最匹配一人产能的定价档位
en: List all fixed and variable costs: domains, per-user API compute, payment fees, and your own hourly floor
Model 3 price/conversion scenarios (bear, base, bull) to find the exact break-even customer count for each
Compare high-volume support burden against higher-ticket focus to pick a price a solo operator can sustain

deliverable.zh: 一张《3 档定价盈亏平衡与毛利测算表》
deliverable.en: A 3-tier Pricing, Margin & Break-Even simulation table

current_stack.zh: 电子表格 / 极简交互式计算器 + 商业测算 Prompt
current_stack.en: Spreadsheet / interactive calculator + unit-economics Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要只按成本加成定价，更不要因为不好意思收钱而把高价值工具定成白菜价。
anti_pattern.en: Don't rely purely on cost-plus pricing, and never underprice high-leverage work out of imposter syndrome.

title.zh: 隐私与开源协议自查表

metaphor.zh: 开源发布前守住版权与用户隐私的合规底线
metaphor.en: Checking license obligations and privacy basics before going public

trigger.zh: 当你准备把个人项目开源到 GitHub 或上线面向公众的静态站，不确定该选什么协议、有没有泄密风险时。
trigger.en: When open-sourcing a repo or launching a public web app and checking for license clashes or leaked secrets.

zh: 根据商业意图选定开源协议（MIT 宽松商用 / Apache 含专利保护 / AGPL 防闭源套壳）并核对第三方依赖兼容性
扫描代码库与 Git 历史，确保零硬编码 API Key、个人邮箱或私有路径残留
若站点使用本地存储或统计代码，在页脚补齐极简透明的隐私声明（如“数据仅存本地，零云端上传”）
en: Match your license to intent (MIT for permissive, Apache for patent grant, AGPL for copyleft) and verify dependency compatibility
Scan the repo and Git history to guarantee zero hardcoded API keys, private emails, or local paths
Add a plain-English privacy note in the footer if using localStorage or analytics

deliverable.zh: 一份通过核验的《LICENSE + 密钥清零 + 隐私声明》发布前包
deliverable.en: A verified pre-release pack: LICENSE file, zero-secrets scan, and plain privacy note

current_stack.zh: 开源协议自查清单 + 本地密钥扫描命令（git grep / gitleaks）
current_stack.en: License checklist + local secret-scanning CLI (git grep / gitleaks)

anti_pattern.zh: 不要以为“删掉最新一次提交里的 API Key”就安全了；只要推过 Git 历史，Key 必须立刻作废重签。
anti_pattern.en: Deleting a leaked API key in a later commit isn't enough—once pushed to Git history, rotate it immediately.

title.zh: 独立报价单与收款防坑模版

metaphor.zh: 把范围、修改次数和首付款写死在开工之前
metaphor.en: Locking scope, revision caps, and deposits before writing a single line

trigger.zh: 当你接独立咨询、定制开发或设计单，怕遇到需求无限膨胀、反复免费返工或干完活被拖欠尾款时。
trigger.en: When taking solo client work and wanting to prevent endless scope creep, free revisions, or ghosted invoices.

zh: 在报价单里明确写出“包含项（In-Scope）”与“明确不包含项（Out-of-Scope）”
绑定免费修改次数上限（如 2 轮），超出部分按透明的按次或按天费率计费
强制执行里程碑付款（如 50% 预付款启动，尾款结清后再移交最终源码或源文件）
en: Explicitly list both In-Scope deliverables and Out-of-Scope exclusions in the proposal
Cap included revisions (e.g., 2 rounds) with a transparent rate for additional changes
Enforce milestone billing (e.g., 50% deposit to start, final source handoff only upon final payment)

deliverable.zh: 一份 1 页纸极简专业《独立项目报价与里程碑确认单》
deliverable.en: A crisp 1-page Solo Proposal & Milestone Agreement template

current_stack.zh: Markdown / PDF 报价单模板 + 范围边界生成 Prompt
current_stack.en: Markdown / PDF proposal template + scope-boundary Prompt

anti_pattern.zh: 不要因为是熟人介绍就省去书面范围确认；越是熟人，口头模糊越容易最后伤感情。
anti_pattern.en: Never skip written scope confirmation for friends or referrals—vague verbal deals ruin relationships fastest.
